label: Native · noise-reduction experiment
method: 3D intensity bilateral filter followed by the same raw-value isosurface threshold
boundaryBandCaveat: The two-voxel raw boundary band preserves measured crop edges but its transition can show a local filtering artifact.

topology.boundaryPolicy: Every topological boundary and nonmanifold edge endpoint is pinned; the ROI is deliberately open.

surfaceDistances.method: 20,000 deterministic area-weighted barycentric samples per direction, closest triangle via vtkStaticCellLocator; sampled, not a Hausdorff guarantee.

conclusion: The filter can remove noise-scale components and can also remove real weak thin structures. Compare with native reference and the untouched source slice; no anatomical no-loss guarantee.
